class.name: AttackMeter
class.brief_description: [color=green](User creatable)[/color] A minigame node that appears when selecting an attack in UT-Godot-Engine.
class.description:
When configuring a [BoxSet] resource in an [Encounter] resource, set the scene made with this node to the meter_scene property. The [BoxSet] resource can be set via the [member Encounter.box_set] property in the [Encounter] resource.
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

method.name: get_base_damage
method.description: Returns the base attack damage by summing the player's attack power and equipment attack bonus. Call this method when calculating attack damage to retrieve the base damage value.

members.member: When the player selects an attack and this node is instantiated, this variable stores the ID of the enemy being targeted.

When the player selects an attack and this node is instantiated, this variable stores the defense value of the enemy being targeted. The defense value must also be calculated directly within this node.
A reference created for efficient control of this node, holding an instance of the [EncounterScript] class. Through this reference, you can implement additional custom functionality.

signal.name: damagetarget
signal.description: A signal emitted when the minigame is successfully completed and the attack lands. It is recommended to call [method Node.queue_free] after emitting this signal to remove this node. [param damage] The final damage of the attack. Determined through custom calculation. [param enemy_id] The ID of the enemy hit by the attack. This can be the same as the value stored in the [member enemy_id] member variable, or you can specify a different enemy for fun. [param crit] Whether the attack is a critical hit. This is passed to the [SlashAnimation] node so that a different animation plays on a critical hit.

signal.name: missed
signal.description: A signal emitted when the minigame fails and the attack misses, or emitted instead of [signal damagetarget] for fun. It is recommended to call [method Node.queue_free] after emitting this signal to remove this node. [param enemy_id] The ID of the enemy the attack missed. This can be the same as the value stored in the [member enemy_id] member variable, or you can specify a different enemy for fun.
